remarks: NOW OFFERING 1 MONTH FREE RENT! 1 BEDROOM + YOUR OWN SEPARATE PRIVATE FLEX/OFFICE SPACE! Bedford Creative brings boutique apartment living to the heart of Downtown Stamford, combining modern finishes, thoughtfully designed amenities, and a unique live/work lifestyle.  This Dual Space One-Bedroom offers something truly different-a private one-bedroom apartment PLUS a separate, dedicated flex space located directly across the hall. Perfect for a private home office, creative studio, workout space, or additional personal space without sacrificing room inside your apartment. Each residence also features its own large private balcony, providing the perfect outdoor extension of your living space for relaxing, entertaining, or enjoying some fresh air.  The residence features a bright, open-concept layout with oversized windows and a contemporary kitchen complete with ENERGY STAR stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and custom cabinetry. The fully electric building is thoughtfully designed with efficiency, comfort, and modern living in mind.  Residents enjoy an impressive collection of amenities, including a fitness center, resident lounge, landscaped outdoor terrace, dog park, and stylish lobby lounge.  Ideally located in the heart of Downtown Stamford, just moments from restaurants, shopping, nightlife, entertainment, and Metro-North, Bedford Creative offers the perfect combination of urban convenience, modern amenities, privacy, and flexible live/work space.
